accounting.rationale: PDF133 defines a data-target eligibility attribute and states a restriction. It does not itself perform pointer assignment, define payload, extend lifetime, or specify argument association.
The target is a data object. Data-pointer targets and procedure-pointer targets are separate canonical categories; TARGET is not a procedure attribute.
Eligibility is conditional on the actual pointer-assignment, argument, type, state, image and lifetime rules. Merely declaring TARGET does not establish association.
The pointer and its target are different entities. Association status, target definition status and allocation status are not interchangeable.
10.2.2 owns assignment syntax and effects, including C1028's eligible variable or pointer-function-result routes and its vector-subscript exclusion. A general expression is not a data target.
The note contrasts explicitly declared targets with targets created by pointer allocation. The latter rule belongs to9.7.1.4p1, not a second local allocation effect.
Type-declaration and TARGET-statement routes retain8.2/R802 and8.6.15/R862-R863 ownership.
Allocation creates a target object; it does not give the pointer entity the forbidden TARGET attribute.

PENDING a canonical9.7.1.4 source/effect relation with successful allocation, explicitly defined payload, a second associated pointer and cleanup only while the allocation remains live. Do not infer a defined initial value.
Reallocation and loss of access to an older allocation remain9.7.1.4 and19.5.2 matters. Listing the dependency grants no case or link credit.
Both original declaration examples are illustrative. They create neither association nor an observable runtime value.
No count-filling program is derived from merely repeating the note's declarations.
The NODE type must already be defined or accessible. HEAD is a target variable, not a pointer because of its name or type.
The shared DIMENSION and TARGET specifications apply to both real variables. Their extents do not prescribe storage bytes, contiguity mechanisms or initialized data.
The designator explanation preserves both TARGET and POINTER endpoints and the possibility of leaving the original object's subobjects by traversing a pointer.
The explanation begins with a TARGET object; it does not confer TARGET on arbitrary expressions or unrelated objects.
The endpoint can have either attribute. This is not a requirement that a pointer component have both, contrary to C866.
Actual association and target availability are required before following a pointer. No traversal of undefined or disassociated pointers is planned.
9.4.2p5 distinguishes a pointer component in an association-status context from its dereferenced target. A designator crossing that pointer can designate an object outside the original aggregate.
An eligible live pointee has its own target eligibility; that is not inheritance of the containing object's lifetime or allocation.
The note explains why the resulting nonpointer object is a target, while C1028, definability, presence and lifetime still constrain operations on it.

requirements.title: A TARGET entity is a variable
requirements.definition: TARGET applies to a variable, not a named constant or procedure entity. It does not require the variable to be a pointer, allocated, already defined, or already associated with a pointer.

pending.ordinary-variable-admission: PENDING complete scalar INTEGER and fixed-rank INTEGER-array variable declarations using TARGET, as compile/positive-controls of the qualified role contrasts. Reuse a source-approved repaired variable control rather than add a separate empty S program. Any later runtime observation first defines payload and establishes pointer association.
pending.named-constant-exclusion: PENDING a complete program with INTEGER, PARAMETER, TARGET :: subject=7, repaired only by removing PARAMETER so the same initialized entity is a variable. C852's nonvariable PARAMETER rule and C865 jointly govern the contradiction; source review must decide canonical ownership/reuse before any isolated C865 credit. Require the actual named-constant-versus-TARGET-variable cause, not generic constant or attribute words.
pending.procedure-entity-source-gate: PENDING a complete explicit-interface dummy or external-procedure declaration plus a separate TARGET statement naming that procedure. Remove only that TARGET statement for the control. R863's object-name and other declaration-role constraints can overlap C865, so first bind the exact procedure role and governing source relation; unsupported PROCEDURE syntax or a missing interface is not an isolated C865 diagnosis.
pending.specification-route-source: PENDING canonical8.2/R802 and8.6.15/R862-R863 relations for TARGET specified in a type declaration versus a separate TARGET statement, including a legitimate array specification. Keep those grammar owners and existing declaration witnesses unchanged; no automatic linkage or duplicate syntax cases.

requirements.oracle: Source-qualified variable admissions and minimally repaired nonvariable declarations. Each negative needs a complete valid control, a causal role report and legitimate staged subject origins. Jointly governing constraints remain explicit gates, not claimed isolated evidence.
requirements.oracle_limitation: 4.2 requires reporting capability for numbered constraints, not rejection, a particular status, printed code or English sentence. Broad role nouns, wrong-source reports, echoes, quoted examples, unsupported features, Internal/ASR/verifier failures, crashes and resource failures cannot establish this predicate. No compiler observations or approvals are supplied.

requirements.title: TARGET and POINTER cannot be attributes of the same entity
requirements.definition: An entity with TARGET does not also have POINTER. A pointer may designate a target without itself acquiring TARGET, and a TARGET object can contain pointer components without giving those components both attributes.

pending.combined-attribute-exclusion: PENDING the complete INTEGER, POINTER, TARGET :: subject contrast with an otherwise empty valid program unit. Removing only TARGET yields a pointer control with no association inquiry or data access; removing only POINTER yields a target-variable control. C854.no-target states the reciprocal conflict, so prefer one independently reviewed canonical pair and a role-preserving source relation instead of cloned C854/C866 negatives. No such link is approved here.
pending.separate-specification-exclusion: PENDING a complete INTEGER, POINTER :: subject declaration followed by TARGET :: subject, repaired only by removing the TARGET statement. Keep declaration ordering, absence of initialization and no pointer use identical. Require the full same-entity POINTER/TARGET incompatibility at its actual legitimate origins; the shared C854 restriction and any distinct-source-span requirement must be adjudicated before credit.
pending.pointer-target-entity-boundary: PENDING canonical10.2.2.2/C1028 and9.7.1.4 relations for a data-target denoted through a defined associated pointer, or created by pointer allocation. A finite control uses two pointers and one live defined target, never a pointer declared TARGET. Observe legal association and independent literal payload only under the canonical mechanism, without retagging its effect or duplicating an execution.

requirements.oracle: One precisely qualified same-entity attribute-conflict family, minimal single-attribute/statement repairs and canonical pointer-versus-pointee source boundaries. C854's defining ownership is preserved.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No fatal status or exact diagnostic vocabulary is mandated. A generic pointer, target or attribute report alone is insufficient; the full conflict and staged origins are required. Pointer declaration is not association, and an undefined pointer is not queried just to make a compile control observable.

requirements.title: TARGET supplies qualified data-pointer target eligibility
requirements.definition: TARGET permits a data object to be a pointer target; an object without target eligibility is not a data-pointer target. This attribute rule neither performs association nor waives the canonical target-expression, type, parameter, rank, state, image or lifetime conditions. In particular, an actual lacking a TARGET declaration can correspond to a TARGET dummy under the separate argument rules; this is not a blanket ban on that call or permanent attribute transfer to the actual.

pending.explicit-live-target-admission: PENDING a complete ordinary INTEGER target t and compatible explicitly nullified pointer p. Define t=17, establish p=>t, guard the now-defined association, assign23 through p and require t=23 plus independent visit/return and exact completion events. This is a meaningful run/positive-control of attribute admission; pointer-assignment effects retain10.2.2 ownership. No address, storage-width or descriptor oracle.
pending.pointer-allocation-source: PENDING a finite canonical9.7.1.4p1 relation: allocate an INTEGER pointer target, define its payload before reading, associate a second pointer, observe literal shared values while live and nullify aliases before cleanup. The allocated object has implicit TARGET; the pointer entity does not. Allocation behavior is not a second local effect derived from informative note1.
pending.nontarget-exclusion-canonical-source: PENDING a complete p=>t declaration/assignment context with a plain nonpointer INTEGER t lacking TARGET, repaired only by adding TARGET to t. C1028 owns this numbered target-eligibility diagnostic; an arbitrary expression or vector-subscripted section has different defects and is not this repair. Keep p1's own diagnostic obligation not-required and gate any reuse on canonical source/case review.
pending.ordinary-target-dummy-source: PENDING canonical15.5.2.4p3/p6 and15.5.2.5p9 relations using a live scalar INTEGER TARGET actual and a non-VALUE TARGET dummy with an explicit interface. A complete future parent can associate a separate output pointer with the dummy and inspect it after normal return only when every persistence condition and target lifetime is proven. Keep scalar/assumed-shape/assumed-rank versus explicit-shape/contiguity branches and15.5.2.14 aliasing conditions distinct.
pending.processor-dependent-dummy-source: PENDING source/documentary gates for15.5.2.5p8's forwarding route andp10's specified discontiguous actual/explicit-shape-or-CONTIGUOUS dummy cases. Record the processor-dependent association alternatives under4.2p6 without inventing copying, address equality, guaranteed persistence or an optional skip for mandatory language support. Do not apply ASSOCIATED to a post-return pointer whose status has not been established as defined.
pending.lifetime-and-presence-source: PENDING canonical context-only/source relations for19.5.2.5p1(3),(6),(7),(10),19.6.6 and15.5.2.13. A non-TARGET actual may be used through a present TARGET dummy during the call, but escaped pointer status can become undefined on return; TARGET+VALUE has its own such rule. Unsaved local-target exit, deallocation and absence do not prescribe a trap, false ASSOCIATED result or retained value. Future complete contexts must reestablish/nullify status without querying it, and guard optional data use with real control flow. No local effect/control role is silently changed to context-only.

requirements.oracle: Finite lawful target-admission positive controls and exact source relations to canonical pointer/argument/lifetime owners. Pure prose does not acquire a universal mandatory-rejection policy. Source-only and context-only dependencies supply no new runtime or facet credit until separately reviewed.
requirements.oracle_limitation: TARGET does not imply POINTER, allocation, initialized data, static lifetime, aliasing permission or a concrete passing ABI. Assigning a target's value to a separate object does not transfer the TARGET attribute; that object needs its own eligibility. ASSOCIATED requires defined pointer status; its two-argument zero-size/zero-storage results differ from mere association. A processor-dependent or undefined status is never read to force an answer. Required runtime mechanisms stay runtime plans even when a processor lacks support.

requirements.title: Nonpointer subobjects inherit their object's TARGET attribute
requirements.definition: Every nonpointer subobject of an object with TARGET also has TARGET. This includes eligible nested and array/character subobjects, not the pointer attribute of pointer components. A pointee reached through a pointer is not thereby a subobject of the original aggregate, and propagation does not establish allocation, association, defined payload or lifetime.

pending.scalar-component-inheritance: PENDING a complete program defining a type with one ordinary INTEGER component and a TARGET scalar object. Define the component as17, associate a compatible pointer with that actual component without declaring the component TARGET, write23 through it and require the parent's component23, association/visit guards and exact completion. Keep10.2.2/C1028 target and definability premises; no unrelated component-grammar negative.
pending.nested-nonpointer-inheritance: PENDING a complete two-level derived object with a nonpointer nonallocatable inner component and an INTEGER leaf. Give only the outer variable TARGET, define the leaf, associate with outer%inner%leaf and observe an independent literal write through the pointer plus distinct completion events.9.4.2p5 must classify the full designator as a subobject; no intervening pointer is inserted.
pending.array-element-and-section-inheritance: PENDING complete TARGET INTEGER-array cases for an actual element and an ordinary triplet section, with defined payload, compatible pointer rank and independent changed/unchanged element literals. Vector subscripts are not a legal target merely because the base has TARGET. A separate empty-section boundary must use the exact16.9.20 association rules without element access or a forced true two-argument ASSOCIATED result; it is not a scalar conversion.
pending.character-substring-inheritance: PENDING a default-kind CHARACTER TARGET of known length, initialized to 'ABCDE', and a compatible length-two pointer to its substring2:3. Change that substring to 'xy' through the pointer and require the independent whole value 'AxyDE', entry/return counts and exact completion. Retain character length/type matching and live definable storage; do not infer source bytes, arbitrary kinds or layout.
pending.allocated-nonpointer-subobject-inheritan: PENDING a TARGET derived object with an ordinary noncoarray allocatable INTEGER component. Successfully allocate and define that component before associating a pointer with it; observe literal changes through the pointer in the parent's component. Nullify the alias before deallocation. The component is a nonpointer subobject, but TARGET propagation alone does not allocate it or make an unallocated target eligible.
pending.pointer-component-boundary: PENDING a TARGET aggregate containing an explicitly associated pointer component and a distinct live target object. Observe the component's pointee through valid designators with literal payload guards, while keeping the component POINTER rather than adding TARGET to it.9.4.2p5 and note3 delimit the pointer-association-status subobject from dereferenced external data. Any mutation and alias must satisfy actual definability and lifetime rules; no fabricated layout or post-exit query.

requirements.oracle: Actual subobjects in complete run/effect programs, compatible live pointers and independent literal changes to the identified parent or pointee, with visit/return/completion guards. Inherited target eligibility is observed without adding TARGET to forbidden component grammar or using a copied object as a proxy.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No automatic declaration effect is credited by a no-op program. Pointer/allocatable state and defined payload are established separately before observation. Zero-size arrays and zero-length strings are always defined under19.6.2, but that is not pointer association or an override of16.9.20's two-argument result. No negative twin, diagnostic mandate, forced runtime trap or compile-only downgrade is invented for this propagation effect.
